message:
The other night, we had a sudden blackout that sent my house into a mini adventure! I grabbed my trusty flashlight and my phone, and within minutes, our family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. My daughter sent a funny meme about ‘cooking by flashlight,’ while my son was busy sharing updates on our neighborhood’s outage status. 

We ended up swapping tips for keeping our phones charged with power banks and brainstorming easy meals we could whip up without power. It turned into a cozy little moment, reminding me that even in the dark, we can still connect and find joy. 

What’s your go-to trick when the lights go out? ☀️
